validation_policy: Minimum video-mean ES L2 EPE at scale 256 on the locked 46-video validation split, every 1000 steps. Step zero logged separately; test not used for selection.
checkpoint_policy: Atomic best adapter checkpoint; latest checkpoint includes optimizer, scheduler, random states and sampling index for resume.
coordinates: Input-image pixel xy coordinates; feature patch centers at patch_size/2 + k*patch_size; boundary distances and Huber residuals use input pixels.
assumptions: LoRA alpha=rank; LoRA on combined QKV, attention projection, fc1 and fc2 in every transformer block.
K-means uses up to 4096 uniformly sampled foreground pixels and 10 Lloyd iterations; FPS selects 12 queries per cluster, repeating only in undersized nonempty clusters.
Two normalized 3x3 convolutions with 16 hidden channels and ReLU follow the cited DINO-Tracker head; local radius 35 input pixels, softmax temperature 1.
The top three teacher matches supervise their own queries; the estimated similarity transform supervises the remaining nine, following Eqs. 4-6. Degenerate groups do not contribute to LSC.
RandomAffine magnitudes and ColorJitter strength are reproduction defaults, not published M2P hyperparameters.
Teacher is a frozen copy of the original DINOv2 initialization; no natural-video M2P pretraining in this experiment.
336x336 training and evaluation use the existing physical field of view. Training pairs use shared affine augmentation; brightness/contrast jitter are independent.
Inference is framewise with chunk_size=1 for numerical consistency across input windows.
frame_sampling: Uniform training video, then two distinct valid-mask frames drawn uniformly over its full annotated cycle; both time directions allowed.
supervision: Myocardial masks only for training; no software point correspondence or EchoTracker2 pseudo-labels.
lsc_reduction: Mean over valid groups of the entire effective batch; accumulation must preserve this denominator.
